speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing neck and arm pain, along with paresthesias and muscle weakness. To better understand your condition, could you please describe exactly where the pain is located and how long you have been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of burning pain in his neck and arms, accompanying paresthesias in his hands. Over the past 3 months, he has experienced increasing weakness in both hands. He has a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, and hypertension. He was involved in a motor vehicle accident 3 years ago.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy with Cervical Radiculopathy.

The patient's history of progressive upper extremity weakness, paresthesias, and burning pain over the past year, combined with a history of motor vehicle accident, strongly suggests cervical spine pathology. Given the chronicity and the presence of motor weakness, I need to assess the structural integrity of the spine. REQUEST IMAGES: Cervical_Spine_MRI. REQUEST TEST: Cervical_Spine_Xray.
